summary: Marex Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the commencement of a consent solicitation for its 6.404% Senior Notes due 2029 to adopt proposed amendments aligning the indenture with recently issued 2031 Notes. The solicitation expires May 15, 2026, offering a $1.00 per $1,000 principal consent payment. This debt restructuring supports the company's proposed redomiciliation to Bermuda, aimed at simplifying corporate structure and regulatory framework. Watch for holder participation rate and progression of the redomiciliation; the risk-arb angle focuses on timing and regulatory approvals.
